scope: Only carriers enumerated by the current adoption-plan inventory. Within a carrier: front-matter keys, then CFEL/GFEL fences inside Claim only; no writes.

deterministic_operations.match: unquoted Formal Claim allowed-value format separator : [format]
Atom.Header.Subjects.Active/Passive/parent address in an unquoted Claim CFEL/GFEL fence

holds: Do not alter = conditions, == required/derived conclusions, or := admissions.
Do not replace slash notation blindly.
Do not transform comments, quoted data, non-CFEL/GFEL fences, Markdown prose, path escapes, or ambiguous colon use.
Every prepared occurrence is pinned to the current source SHA and a predicted postimage SHA.
90% guard per context: require all scope, masking, exact-token, and current-pin checks; otherwise hold the span.
